g.text: Weaver / execution authority and responsibility boundaries
Who defines meaning, integrates cloud state and controls the final send?

g.text: DESIGN ASSURANCE / CONTRACTS, NOT REQUEST TRAFFIC

text.tspan: POO defines governed effects across requests; the runtime preserves one-use state, history and budget.
Quint / Lean links constrain the design. Each send needs current admission, a typed claim and the final broker gate.
